b: Creating reference for "Birthday Pageant" felt like waking up in a dream.
I based the painting on a procession that we staged in our backyard with neighborhood kids wearing homemade costumes.

The moment was captured by LIFE magazine photographer Tobey Sanford. A friend who worked at the hardware store built the foam stegosaurus and hauled it over in the back of his pickup.
With scenes like this, I’ve found it works best to pose kids in groups and to let them have fun. They'll give you expressions and interactions you can’t get by posing them one at a time.
